title: AWS IAM Account Enumeration
description: Detects broad IAM user/role/credential enumeration (ListUsers, ListRoles, GetAccountAuthorizationDetails, ListAccessKeys, GenerateCredentialReport). Adds general Cloud Account discovery (T1087.004) beyond the existing SigmaHQ rule which only flags GetCallerIdentity from the TruffleHog user agent.
falsePositives: Cloud security posture and credential-report tooling.
